Repository: sphinx-doc/sphinx Base commit: 56772395bb945099a6d5331501c179dd2831fa1c ### Issue Convert :kbd: to nested HTML elements **Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.** [:kbd:](https://www.sphinx-doc.org/en/master/usage/restructuredtext/roles.html#role-kbd) describes "a sequence of keystrokes". Sphinx converts it to a single [``](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/kbd) element: ``` :kbd:`Control-x Control-f` ``` becomes ```html Control-x Control-f ``` **Describe the solution you'd like** Potentially sphinx could parse the `:kbd:` value and convert it to individual (or nested) `` elements, which is what [MDN suggests](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/kbd#Representing_keystrokes_within_an_input) as a way to represent key combinations. Something like: ```html <-- Individual --> Control-x Control-f <-- Nested --> Control-x Control-f ``` **Describe alternatives you've considered** Alternatively the sphinx user could rewrite their markup: ``` :kbd:`Control`\ -\ :kbd:`x` :kbd:`Control`\ -\ :kbd:`f` ``` **Related** - https://github.com/sphinx-doc/sphinx/issues/3160 - https://github.com/sphinx-doc/sphinx/pull/4197 ### Candidate patch ```diff diff --git a/simulate_kbd_output.py b/simulate_kbd_output.py new file mode 100644 index 000000000..8d6ce0b06 --- /dev/null +++ b/simulate_kbd_output.py @@ -0,0 +1,16 @@ +def simulate_kbd_output(key_sequence): + keys = key_sequence.split() + html_output = [] + + for key in keys: + key_parts = key.split('-') + for part in key_parts: + html_output.append('{}'.format(part)) + if key is not keys[-1]: + html_output.append('-') + + return ' '.join(html_output) + +# Test the function with an example key sequence +key_sequence = 'Control-x Control-f' +print(simulate_kbd_output(key_sequence)) diff --git a/sphinx/writers/html.py b/sphinx/writers/html.py index 85eeb4376..d3f088104 100644 --- a/sphinx/writers/html.py +++ b/sphinx/writers/html.py @@ -491,16 +491,25 @@ class HTMLTranslator(SphinxTranslator, BaseTranslator): # overwritten def visit_literal(self, node: Element) -> None: if 'kbd' in node['classes']: - self.body.append(self.starttag(node, 'kbd', '', - CLASS='docutils literal notranslate')) + keys = node.astext().split() + for key in keys: + key_parts = key.split('-') + for part in key_parts: + self.body.append(self.starttag(node, 'kbd', '', CLASS='docutils literal notranslate')) + self.body.append(part) + self.body.append('') + if key is not keys[-1]: + self.body.append('-') + raise nodes.SkipNode else: self.body.append(self.starttag(node, 'code', '', CLASS='docutils literal notranslate')) self.protect_literal_text += 1 - def depart_literal(self, node: Element) -> None: - if 'kbd' in node['classes']: - self.body.append('') + # Since kbd tags are handled in visit_literal, we do not need to do anything here for kbd + if 'kbd' not in node['classes']: + self.protect_literal_text -= 1 + self.body.append('') else: self.protect_literal_text -= 1 self.body.append('') diff --git a/temp_kbd_test/conf.py b/temp_kbd_test/conf.py new file mode 100644 index 000000000..b84f71094 --- /dev/null +++ b/temp_kbd_test/conf.py @@ -0,0 +1,6 @@ +extensions = [] +templates_path = ['_templates'] +source_suffix = '.rst' +master_doc = 'index' +html_theme = 'alabaster' +exclude_patterns = ['_build', 'Thumbs.db', '.DS_Store'] diff --git a/temp_kbd_test/index.rst b/temp_kbd_test/index.rst new file mode 100644 index 000000000..b2e001d11 --- /dev/null +++ b/temp_kbd_test/index.rst @@ -0,0 +1,4 @@ +Test kbd role +============= + +This is a test for the :kbd:`Control-x Control-f` role. diff --git a/test_kbd_role.py b/test_kbd_role.py new file mode 100644 index 000000000..64e920fb0 --- /dev/null +++ b/test_kbd_role.py @@ -0,0 +1,59 @@ +import os +import shutil +from sphinx.application import Sphinx + +# Create a temporary directory for the Sphinx project +project_dir = 'temp_kbd_test' +if not os.path.exists(project_dir): + os.makedirs(project_dir) + +conf_py = """\ +extensions = [] +templates_path = ['_templates'] +source_suffix = '.rst' +master_doc = 'index' +html_theme = 'alabaster' +exclude_patterns = ['_build', 'Thumbs.db', '.DS_Store'] +""" + +# Write the conf.py file +with open(os.path.join(project_dir, 'conf.py'), 'w') as f: + f.write(conf_py) + +# Create an index.rst file with the :kbd: role +index_rst = """\ +Test kbd role +============= + +This is a test for the :kbd:`Control-x Control-f` role. +""" + +# Write the index.rst file +with open(os.path.join(project_dir, 'index.rst'), 'w') as f: + f.write(index_rst) + +# Function to build the project and print the output +def build_and_print_output(): + #
